metadata.clan_summary:
[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC bob-cli-ji[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Private event notes for Google Calendar events[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]Bryan can give any Google Calendar event (including events other [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]people own and invitations he has not answered yet) Bob-only [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]metadata at RSVP time: `@route`, `#off`/`#on`, `-30 reason`, `+15 [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]reason`, and prose. He can write it from the CLI, over SSH, or from[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]Bob Mac Capture. The metadata lands on the event's Event Task [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]exactly as if those lines were in the Google description, and it [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]beats that description field by field. Bob never writes to Google: [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]it validates notes at write time, previews them faithfully, and [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]never drops one silently.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]7[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]5[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]
[dim]   Path: [#87AFFF][/dim]plan:202611/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]private_gcal_event_notes.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim] Prompt: [#87AFFF][/dim]prompts/202611/private_gcal_event_notes.md[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Bead: [#87AFFF][/dim]bob-cli-ji[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Page: [#87AFFF][/dim]https://github.com/bobs-org/bob-cli--beads/blob/main/pages/bob-cli-ji/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]README.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Note store and per-field layering engine[/bold #D7AFFF]                      [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]engine[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]engine: add the `gcal.note` journal record and its last-writer-wins [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]fold, parse notes on the plain-text description path, and layer [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]occurrence and series notes over Google's description in [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`snapshot::fetch_day`. Give the root a note-first source, keep note [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]bullets outside the cap, mark notes in `list` and `sync`, add list JSON [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]identity fields, and test it all with hand-written journal records.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]bob gcal note command, event selection and read-only modes[/bold #D7AFFF]    [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]select[dim] · [dim][/dim]after engine[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]select: add the `bob gcal note` command skeleton and its option [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]pre-pass. Select an event by title query across a 90-day window, `-D`, a[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]pasted Google Calendar URL, or `-i`/`-C`. Add the TTY picker and the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]This event / All events scope prompt, widen the organizer fields, and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]add the list (`-l`, `-a`) and show modes with their JSON contract, help,[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and catalog row.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Note provenance in gcal.row and fail-safe reads[/bold #D7AFFF]               [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]hardening[dim] · [dim][/dim]after engine[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]hardening: journal which fields a private note contributed to each [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`gcal.row`, hold those fields with a warning when a note can no longer [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]be read because journal lines are malformed, and word `kept_description`[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]for the input that actually changed.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Writing, previewing, and applying notes[/bold #D7AFFF]                       [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]write[dim] · [dim][/dim]after select[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]write: normalize one-line and multi-line input into canonical lines [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]using shared vectors, and reject bad routes and conflicts at write time.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]Show the faithful 'lands as' preview and terminal time rail, then save [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]or clear. Report saved versus applied, and on the writer run the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]immediate sync. Add the preview and save JSON with highlight spans, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]golden JSON fixtures for the Mac, and the `docs/gcal-notes.md` contract.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Editor, adopt, doctor check, and fragile-description hint[/bold #D7AFFF]     [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]extras[dim] · [dim][/dim]after write[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]extras: add `-e` editing in $EDITOR with a scissors help block and `-A` [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]to adopt directive and reason lines from a fragile Google description. [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]Add a doctor `notes` check for orphans, unresolved routes, and foreign [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]accounts, and a `bob gcal list` hint for directives that live only in [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]someone else's description.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  6 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Decision record, glossary term, and guide[/bold #D7AFFF]                     [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]records[dim] · [dim][/dim]after write, hardening[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]records: add the 'Private Event Notes Beat Google Per Field' decision [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]record with supersession marks and the glossary term (each per its [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]memory decision), add the 'Plan an event you don't own' guide, and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]record the follow-ups this epic leaves out.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  7 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Bob Mac Capture Event note mode[/bold #D7AFFF]                               [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
    [#AF87FF]mac[dim] · [dim][/dim]after write, records[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]mac: in the bob-mac-capture linked repo, add an Event note mode to the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]capture panel: open it with a chord, the status menu, or a Calendar-band[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]row; pick from upcoming events, edit with bob's highlight spans, and see[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]a live hatched time rail with the 'lands as' preview. Save, clear, and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]undo, all through `bob gcal note -f json`, with docs, tests, and green [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]exact-SHA macOS CI.[/#D7D7AF]
